notes.note:
Fixed an issue where pages would unexpectedly scroll back to the top when selecting text. ([Bug 2081016][1]) 

  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2081016

Fixed a crash on Windows when printing or saving a page as PDF while a screen reader or other assistive technology was running. ([Bug 2082376][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2082376

Fixed an issue where Firefox was opening windows on the wrong monitor in multi-monitor setups on Linux. ([Bug 2076558][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2076558

Fixed an issue that could prevent the built-in VPN from turning on for some users. ([Bug 2055094][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2055094

Fixed an issue where files dragged into Firefox from other applications were not dropped onto the page on macOS. ([Bug 2078954][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2078954

system_requirements:
## Windows

### Operating Systems (32-bit and 64-bit)
 - Windows 10 or later

### Recommended Hardware
-  1 gigahertz (GHz) or faster compatible processor or System on a Chip (SoC)
-  1GB of RAM / 2GB of RAM for the 64-bit version
-  500MB of hard drive space

---

## Mac

### Operating Systems
- macOS 10.15 or later 

### Recommended Hardware
- Macintosh computer with an Intel x86 or Apple silicon processor
- 512 MB of RAM
- 200 MB hard drive space

---

## GNU/Linux

### Software Requirements

*Please note that GNU/Linux distributors may provide packages for your distribution which have different requirements.*


- Firefox will not run at all without the following libraries or packages:
    - glibc 2.17 or higher (glibc 2.28 or higher on arm64)
    - GTK+ 3.14 or higher
    - libglib 2.42 or higher
    - libstdc++ 4.8.1 or higher (libstdc++ 6.0 or higher on arm64)
    - X.Org 1.0 or higher (1.7 or higher is recommended)
- For optimal functionality, we recommend the following libraries or packages:
    - DBus 1.0 or higher
    - NetworkManager 0.7 or higher
    - PulseAudio
